cohort: The study included 3652 women who delivered at a tertiary maternity hospital in Kenya between January 1, 2018, and December 31, 2019, comparing those with and without Hypertensive Disorders of Pregnancy (HDP).
finding: Women with Hypertensive Disorders of Pregnancy (HDP) had a significantly increased risk of both maternal composite complications (adjusted risk ratio 3.34) and perinatal composite complications (adjusted risk ratio 1.38) compared to normotensive women.
